layoutApproach: Public read-only doc: collapsible TOC (left) + content center + feedback-only right panel (pending/submitted). Selection tooltip is the primary feedback input. Bottombar shows expiry. Deliberately no forward navigation (dead end by design) and no review/execute/file APIs.

responsive.mobile: Single column content; TOC & feedback slide-in hidden overlays; selection tooltip stays; bottombar shows expiry.
responsive.tablet: TOC (240px) + content + feedback drawer; grid auto-hides right on narrow viewport.
responsive.desktop: TOC + content + feedback rail (380px); content width autosizes.

interactionMap.file selection: open feedback tooltip (add todo / submit review)
